ls components/controls; echo ====; cat components/Checkbox.md; echo ====; cat components/Button.md | head -120
cat components/controls/TextInput.md | head -150; echo ====; cat components/controls/PasswordInput.md | head -120; echo ====; sed -n '/## Properties/,$p' components/Button.md | head -60

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && grep -rhoE "\-\-g-spacing-[a-z0-9-]+:" styles | sort -u | head -20; grep -rn "Lang" build/esm/utils/configure.d.ts | head -5; grep -rn "ru" build/esm/utils/configure.d.ts | head -3; cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npx tsc --version && ls node_modules/.bin | grep -E "^(tsc|vite|vitest)$"

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && grep -n -E "header-[0-9]|subheader-[0-9]" build/docs/guides/typography.md | head -10; grep -n -A12 "## Properties" build/docs/components/Text.md | head -30; grep -n "as\b" build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5; find build/esm/components -name "Text*.d.ts" | head -3

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npm run build 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" | tail -40

which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome firefox 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; npm ls -g --depth=0 2>/dev/null | grep -i -E "playwright|puppeteer"; python3 -c "import playwright" 2>&1 | tail -1

cd /tmp/pwcheck && sed -i "s#ssr: { noExternal: true },#ssr: { noExternal: ['@gravity-ui/uikit'] },#; s#await server.ssrLoadModule('react-dom/server')#await import('/home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/react-dom/server.js')#; s#await server.ssrLoadModule('react')#await import('/home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/react/index.js')#" ssr-run.mjs && timeout 120 node ssr-run.mjs 2>&1 | head -150

pkill -f "vite preview" ; rm -rf dist && git status --short && git diff -- package.json && npm audit --omit=dev 2>/dev/null | tail -3; npm audit 2>/dev/null | grep -E "^[a-z@].*(Severity|severity)" | head; npm audit --json 2>/dev/null | node -e "let s='';process.stdin.on('data',d=>s+=d).on('end',()=>{const j=JSON.parse(s);console.log(Object.keys(j.vulnerabilities||{}).map(k=>k+':'+j.vulnerabilities[k].severity+':'+(j.vulnerabilities[k].via||[]).filter(v=>typeof v==='object').map(v=>v.title).join(';')).join('\n'))})"
